messages.subject: Rattle on Mac - Grey box then crash
messages.subject_clean: Rattle on Mac - Grey box then crash
messages.body_plain:
I attempting to debug why Rattle will not run in R (Mac OSX Mountain Lion). When I run rattle(), a graphic box appears for a second and then disappears. The I receive an error that the application has quit unexpectedly.

I have loaded the Gtk2, Cairo. I have installed X11. I have tried opening rattle in RStudio and it crashes as well. I have read a number of other posts with similar problems. Does the report below give any clues as to what the issue is with my attempts?

messages.body_plain:
I just went through this just last week.  You have done everything correctly.  The problem appears to be in the binaries of R for Mac, GTK ( from r.research.att), and cairoDevice.  They don't seem to link together correctly.  Several package authors are aware of the issue and are working to resolve.  There is no published time course of when this will happen.  Dr Verzani has had success in re-compiling all the source code (R, GTK, RGtk2, and cairoDevice) but that is well beyond my skill level.  The Rattle 'troubleshooting installation on Mac' speaks of using older versions of R and Rattle() in the meanwhile.

Bob Aronoff

messages.subject: function pmmlCanExport missing
messages.body_plain:
Using R 3.0.2 64 bit on Windows 8.  as described in the book, I launch rattle and click on execute, ask for the weather dataset to be loaded and get the following error message

Error in ifelse(pmmlCanExport(variables[i]), "", Rtxt(". No code export")) :
  could not find function "pmmlCanExport"

search () shows following packages

[1] ".GlobalEnv"         "package:pmml"       "package:XML"        "package:colorspace" "package:RGtk2"      "package:rattle"     "package:stats"      "package:graphics"   "package:grDevices"  "package:utils"      "package:datasets"
[12] "package:methods"    "Autoloads"          "package:base"

when I check the functions in pmml, I get

pmml.ada          pmml.coxph        pmml.cv.glmnet    pmml.glm          pmml.hclust       pmml.itemsets     pmml.kmeans       pmml.ksvm         pmml.lm           pmml.multinom     pmml.naiveBayes   pmml.nnet
pmml.randomForest pmml.rfsrc        pmml.rpart        pmml.rules        pmml.svm          pmml::

and when I enter
 pmmlCanExport(y)  I get

Error: could not find function "pmmlCanExport".

I have no idea what to do next.  Any one help?

Thanks in advance.

messages.subject: Re: function pmmlCanExport missing
messages.body_plain:
The pmmlCanExport is an issue with the new release of the pmml package - it is being addressed at present - a quick fix:

> pmmlCanExport <- function(...) TRUE
> rattle()

Regards,

Graham Williams
http://togaware.com
